best_for: FitEnvelope draws where the package fits and what it does not take as a boundary: our polypropylene package stands inside a dashed "fits" envelope with its rated temperature range as a steel-blue band at the foot, and every exclusion hangs outside the envelope as a numbered tag tied to its edge.
